notes: Upper supporting wall/assembly is absent and must be proposed externally. Per-view lower rail tips differ from generic pivot. Rung count/width are approximate; no climb connector authored.

Local-east dominant width/ridge axis follows the original E up-right/down-left member tangent (local Y). This is a single physical authoring convention; source art, camera rows, pivots and runtime yaw are unchanged.

animation_registration.interpretation: Animation/media registration only, not a contact/footprint/mount height. No offsets or states adjusted.

source_geometry_limitations.method: Material-specific source masks: separate crate lid/wall planks, table cloth/legs, cart wheels/canvas/cargo/side boards. Thin source-UV painted surfaces, Blender rigid-body support loss for wood and payload; independently folded cloth surface. No common lateral launch or filled interior hull. Final support loss uses authored rigid rotation toward the floor and ballistic center lowering with exact vertex floor contact; no member scaling. Input baked geometry/motion retained exactly; planar original-shadow continuity and projected shard contact cues added.
source_geometry_limitations.limitation: Directional 2.5D surfaces, not a universal 3D reconstruction. Member segmentation is authored from projected art; hidden sides use wood-tone paint. Cloth fall/folding authored, not a cloth solver. Fragment mutual collisions excluded at original cut joints to prevent artificial launch; independent visual review required. This revision replaces the unstable balance simulation with authored support-loss paths, not a rigid-body simulation.
source_geometry_limitations.blender_inspection: not opened; no geometry dimensions claimed from Blender; source metadata explicitly describes directional painted surfaces rather than certified native collision
